title: closerouter config
description: Configuration for closerouter, a lightweight OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy/router.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI this config validates against.

port.description: Port the proxy listens on. Defaults to 6712.

key.description: Optional API key clients must present to access the proxy.

providers.description: Map of provider name to its configuration. Must contain at least one entry.

provider.description: A backend provider that speaks the OpenAI API format.

base_url.description: Base URL of the provider's OpenAI-compatible API.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate with the provider.

models.description: Models exposed through this provider. Each entry may be a bare model id string or a full model entry object.

model.description: A model exposed by a provider. Either a bare id string (e.g. "deepseek-v4-flash") or an object whose only required field is "id". Additional fields (e.g. "owned_by") are passed through to clients.
